title: Grilled Portuguese Fish Wrap
description: A delicious and flavorful Portuguese-inspired dish featuring fresh fish wrapped in a crusty wrap, served with a side of tangy slaw.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, garlic, and 1/4 teaspoon of ocean salt.
3. Brush the mixture on both sides of the fish pieces and let marinate for 10 minutes.
4. Grill the fish for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, mix together mayonnaise and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
6. Slaw: Shred 1 cup of cabbage and mix with the mayonnaise mixture.
7. Warm the Portuguese wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
8. Assemble the wraps by placing a piece of grilled fish on each wrap, followed by a spoonful of slaw.
9. Serve immediately and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
